fields.v: Partly (0.5): negative and mixed results reported (free retrieval brings limited gains or hurts; summary reuse does not reduce cost on Lite), but abstract claims 'significantly' improve accuracy and reduce token cost without statistical tests
fields.quote: Thus, in this setup, summary-based reuse does not reduce cost relative to the baseline, and autonomous retrieval tends to increase repository access and overall token consumption.
fields.why: The paper reports its negative and mixed results in the body and conclusion, so No (0) may be too strict; the overclaims in the abstract fit Partly better (as scored for similar papers).
fields.doubt: O artigo reporta resultados negativos (recuperação livre piora, resumos não baixam o custo no Lite, pág. 8 e 10); o problema é só o 'significantly' do resumo sem testes. Isso parece Parcial (0,5), não Não (0). Decide Q9.
